releases.notes:
Beta 2.5.0 is available for Minecraft 1.21.1 on both the Fabric and Neoforge platforms

### Native Builds for both platforms!
This is the first multi-platform release, removing the requirement for Sinytra Connector on Neoforge and reducing bugs and incompatibility issues on that platform.

### New Additions
* Added the "Levita Harness", crafted using Levita Beads and Flaxweave and allows you to anchor yourself at a y level to help with building and crossing gaps
* Added Flaxweave Boots that have inherent feather falling, powder snow walking, and skulk sensor immunity
* Added an exclusive enchantment "Rending" (I-III) for the Bloomed Blade which has a chance to grant additional souls when collecting a new mob
* Added Ominous bottles to Birdcage loot tables and added Ominous Trial wave rewards including a new exclusive Moa breed
* Added Breezes as uncommon natural spawns in Paradise
* Added Levita Arrows can be crafted (and looted) which have inverted gravity
* Enhanced Levita Rails to support floating up and down slopes to allow for more creative uses
  * Also added a new rare room to the Palace to showcase the rails

### Fixes
* Fixed several incompatibilities with other mods that prevented loading, locked up, or caused crashes including Wilder Wild and Atmospheric
* Fixed the Glazed Gold Upgrade Recipe not duplicating correctly
* Fixed issues with Calcite Flower Pots
* Various other minor fixes on the Neoforge version, fixed by now being a native version
* Fixed items placed in tree taps and incubators only facing one way, and not rotating with the player's facing

### Other Changes
* Added the `paradise_lost:is_paradise_lost` biome tag for ease of use in addons or modpacks

releases.notes:
Beta 2.2.1 is here, including mostly bug fixes for 2.2.0... but a few features that I missed in that release are also included here!

## Bugs fixed in b2.2.1:

- Missing translation keys for Envoy and updated translations for some blocks (grass path)
- Fixed missing particles and sound when detonating a Nitra bunch with Redstone
- Levita and Levita Ore will now break at the height limit to prevent them from rising and falling forever
- Tree Taps on bee nests require the honey level to be full

## Additions in b2.2.1:

- Added a path variant for Permafrost
- Healing splash potions can be used to make Bloomed Calcite 
  - Each potion can convert 1-2 Calcite where it lands
- Nitra Bulbs are throwable an explode on hit
  - Explosion only damages entities
  - 5 second cooldown between throws

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Added a warning message for server owners about world creation.
- Wisteria foliage is now bonemeal-able
- Orange fruit items are now scattered instead of spawned from leaves
- Modified wisteria & golden oak trunk generation
- Renamed logger

## Fixes

- Fixed several subtitles. e.g. "Phantom flaps" -> "Moa glides"
- Bloodstones no longer crash upon use on a non-living entity.
- Fixed several incompatibilities related to shaders and performance mods
- Improved client-side sign registration
- Fixed a bug that prevented the user from customizing a superflat world

## Advisory: 1.17 ➝ 1.18 World Migration

At this time, migrating worlds will work fine all elements of the mod **except** for dimension information.

Due to unforeseen issues currently beyond our control, the game is currently unable to migrate the Aether Dimension from the 1.17 format to 1.18s.

Anyone choosing to migrate worlds is **strongly encouraged** to make a backup and additionally opt to regenerate the dimension due to the worldgen changes made,
as even if this component is stabilized, **there is no chunk blending in place for world transitions**.

(The Aether Dimension can be regenerated by removing the folder `<MC_SAVES_FOLDER>/<WORLD_NAME>/dimensions/paradise_lost`)

Efforts are currently ongoing to determine the feasibility of getting this component working, to ensure a smoother migration to 1.18.x.
Further news regarding this effort can be found on our [discord server](https://discord.com/invite/wmMa47n).

mods.name: The Aether
mods.description: The Aether is a dimension high in the sky composed of floating islands. Ascend through a Glowstone portal and begin a new survival adventure packed with new ores, mythical creatures and perilous Dungeons. All you need to do is build a Glowstone frame and add water to light the mystical portal, step in and you'll be transported immediately to the luscious hostile paradise known as the Aether.
